mapper.sql: select p.id, p.instance_id, p.customer_id, p.node_name, p.node_type, p.address, p.port, p.url, p.config_json, p.domain_policy_json, p.expire_time, p.custom_id, p.status, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, (select ifnull(sum(ifnull(t.rx_delta, 0) + ifnull(t.tx_delta, 0)), 0) from res_proxy_node_traffic t where t.node_id = p.id) as total_traffic_bytes from res_proxy_node p
mapper.select: where expire_time is not null and expire_time < #{maxExpireTime} and (status = '0' or status is null) order by expire_time asc
where expire_time is not null and expire_time >= #{fromTime} and expire_time <= #{toTime} and (status = '0' or status is null) order by expire_time asc
select port from res_proxy_node where instance_id = #{instanceId} and port is not null order by port
select count(1) from res_proxy_node where instance_id = #{instanceId}
select count(1) from res_proxy_node where customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: insert into res_proxy_node (instance_id, customer_id, node_name, node_type, address, port, url, config_json, domain_policy_json, expire_time, custom_id, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{instanceId}, #{customerId}, #{nodeName}, #{nodeType}, #{address}, #{port}, #{url}, #{configJson}, #{domainPolicyJson}, #{expireTime}, #{customId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.delete:
